messages.Câmp magnetic, inducție și transfer de e: Magnetic field, induction and energy transfer
messages.Prezice direcția busolei înainte să inve: Predict the compass direction before reversing the poles.
messages.Ce se întâmplă cu tensiunea când magnetu: What happens to the voltage when the magnet stops?
messages.Poate curentul bobinei să se schimbe ins: Can the coil current change instantly?
messages.Dublarea tensiunii dublează și puterea d: Does doubling the voltage also double the available power?
messages.La flux maxim, tensiunea este maximă sau: At maximum flux, is the voltage maximum or zero?
messages.Dipol punctual, câmp exterior. Regiunea: Point dipole, external field. The region r < 0.01 m is excluded. Arrows indicate direction, not field magnitude. Schematic drawing.
messages.Dipol în câmp îndepărtat; autoinductanță: Far-field dipole; self-inductance neglected. x = 0.10–0.50 m; the magnet does not pass through the coil. +x points left and the normal n points right. Positive current follows the right-hand rule about n. Drawn turns are representative.
messages.Circuit RL liniar, miez ideal; fără satu: Linear RL circuit, ideal core; no saturation, hysteresis or core losses. B is the mean field in the core cross-section. Discharge retains a closed loop through R. N = 200, A = 0.001 m².
messages.Flux comun impus, cuplaj perfect, fără p: Prescribed common flux, perfect coupling, no losses or magnetising current. i₁ enters from the source; i₂ flows to the load. At ω = 0 the flux is constant; this does not simulate connecting a battery.
messages.Bobină rotativă în câmp uniform, mișcare: Rotating coil in a uniform field, prescribed motion and resistive circuit. A = 0.01 m², r = 2 Ω. Self-inductance and friction are neglected. Schematic drawing; high frequencies may produce visual aliasing.
Drag the probe or use its coordinates. Arrow keys: keyboard movement.
messages.Trage magnetul. În pauză configurezi o m: Drag the magnet. While paused, configure a new measurement; while running, produce induction. Arrow keys: keyboard movement.
messages.Comutarea sursei păstrează curentul. Pas: Switching the source preserves current. Step = 0.001 s; default playback 0.01 simulated seconds / real second.
messages.Φ este fluxul unei spire. Tensiunea și c: Φ is the flux through one turn. The displayed voltage and current belong to the secondary.
messages.Φ este fluxul unei spire; λ = NΦ. Unghiu: Φ is the flux through one turn; λ = NΦ. Angle θ is measured from the coil normal. A field can exist without induced voltage: the change in flux matters.
messages.Curentul indus se opune variației fluxul: Induced current opposes the change in flux, not always the existing field. The agent moving the magnet supplies the energy dissipated in the resistor. An open circuit can have voltage but no current.
messages.Fluxul dipolului se integrează pe discul: Dipole flux is integrated over the coil disc; we do not multiply the central field by the area. m is the magnetic moment, a the coil radius and x the axial distance.
messages.La comutare, curentul rămâne continuu. E: Current remains continuous during switching. Magnetic energy is stored and can be dissipated during discharge. L is the effective inductance of the linear core.
messages.Creșterea tensiunii este însoțită de scă: Increasing voltage is accompanied by decreasing current for the same transmitted power. These ratios apply to the ideal model; applied DC voltage is not modelled.
messages.Rotația bobinei schimbă fluxul într-un c: Coil rotation changes the flux in a constant field. At a flux extremum, voltage is zero. The external drive compensates the electromagnetic torque.
messages.SI: B în T; flux în Wb; tensiune în V; c: SI: B in T; flux in Wb; voltage in V; current in A; resistance in Ω; inductance in H; energy in J; power in W; x and a in m; area in m²; time in s; ω in rad/s; m in A·m². N is dimensionless. Analytical models do not depend on frame rate. Motion energy is integrated numerically with a convergence check.
messages.m = 1 A·m², x = 0,10 m, y = 0. Determină: m = 1 A·m², x = 0.10 m, y = 0. Find the axial field.
messages.Bₓ = μ₀m/(2πx³) = 0,2 mT; Bᵧ = 0. Invers: Bₓ = μ₀m/(2πx³) = 0.2 mT; Bᵧ = 0. Reversing the poles reverses vector B.
messages.N = 100, a = 0,05 m, m = 1 A·m², x = 0,1: N = 100, a = 0.05 m, m = 1 A·m², x = 0.10 m, v = −0.1 m/s, R = 10 Ω. Values immediately before stopping at the limit.
U = 10 V, R = 10 Ω, L = 0.1 H, i(0) = 0. Calculate i and the energies at t = 0.01 s.
messages.N₁ = 200, N₂ = 100, Φ₀ = 0,001 Wb, ω = 1: N₁ = 200, N₂ = 100, Φ₀ = 0.001 Wb, ω = 100 rad/s, R = 10 Ω. Compare RMS values and power.
messages.N = 100, B = 0,5 T, A = 0,01 m², ω = 10π: N = 100, B = 0.5 T, A = 0.01 m², ω = 10π rad/s, R = 20 Ω, r = 2 Ω. Find e and i at t = 0.05 s.
messages.e = 15,70796327 V; i = 0,713998330 A; P_: e = 15.70796327 V; i = 0.713998330 A; P_mech = 11.21545955 W. Energy comes from mechanical work.
messages.Un magnet staționar lângă o bobină produ: Does a stationary magnet next to a coil produce continuous current?
messages.Fluxul poate fi nenul, dar constant; atu: Flux can be nonzero but constant; then e = 0.
messages.La flux maxim într-un generator, tensiun: At maximum flux in a generator, instantaneous voltage is…
The flux derivative is zero at an extremum.
messages.Circuitul întrerupt impune i = 0, nu e =: An open circuit imposes i = 0, not e = 0.
messages.La oprirea alimentării RL prin comutare: When the RL source is disconnected by switching to a resistor…
Energy Li²/2 is dissipated in the resistor.
messages.Tensiunea și curentul se transformă în r: Voltage and current transform in inverse ratios.
messages.N = 200, A = 0,01 m², B crește de la 0,1: N = 200, A = 0.01 m², B rises from 0.1 to 0.3 T in 0.5 s, R = 10 Ω. Result: e = −0.8 V; i = −0.08 A; P = 0.064 W.
messages.Documentare prin Firecrawl: 4 noiembrie: Research via Firecrawl: 4 November 2026. Five documents, three institutions. Original text and drawings; the simulation works without external services.
The compass aligns with the local B vector.
messages.Direcție nedefinită: câmp nul sau regiun: Undefined direction: zero field or excluded region.
messages.Graficele arată istoricul măsurat. Curso: Graphs show the measured history. The cursor marks the scene time; each axis has its own SI scale.
messages.Parametrii se configurează în pauză și î: Configure parameters while paused to start a new measurement. Slow playback does not change the physics.
messages.Miez liniar ideal, fără saturație. Comut: Ideal linear core, no saturation. Switching preserves current. Step = 0.001 s; playback 0.01 s / s. The +/− marks and i arrow define sign references; negative current flows in reverse. R includes the coil and circuit resistance.
messages.Acele sunt indicatoare schematice; citeș: Needles are schematic indicators; read SI values in the cards.
messages.Două inele izolate și două perii leagă b: Two insulated slip rings and two brushes connect the rotating coil to the circuit. Voltmeter U stays in parallel; the switch disconnects only R. U = e − r·i; the e card shows the emf. θ is the angle between B and normal n.
